title: perf: Add fast path for parsing simple versions (digits and dots only)

verdicts.label: intended
verdicts.rationale: The PR adds a fast‑path for versions that contain only digits and dots. In that path it explicitly catches a `ValueError` from `int()` conversion and re‑raises it as `packaging.version.InvalidVersion`. This makes the exception type more specific and matches the library’s own error hierarchy, so the new behavior is deliberate.
evidence: except ValueError:        raise InvalidVersion(f'Invalid version: {version!r}') from None
rejected: self._release = tuple(map(int, version.split('.')))  # fast path parse  # noqa: E501  # pragma: no cover  # ... (truncated for brevity)  # Actually quoting exact lines:  # except ValueError:  #     raise InvalidVersion(f'Invalid version: {version!r}') from None
